title: Silver Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?
summary: This document explains Silver Account interest: the APY is tier-based (2.5% or 4.0%), interest accrues daily on your daily balance and is compounded daily using a daily periodic rate derived from your APY. Accrued interest is credited monthly; if your balance changes tiers, the APY applied each day matches that day’s tier, and the cycle’s interest is the sum of daily accruals. It also lists credit card bonus APYs for specific Rho-Bank credit cards (e.g., EcoCard +2.2%, Gold Rewards Card +0.5%, Crypto-Cash Back Card +0.5%).
